fields.statement: Built binary (go build at 1913524), fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin: rhiza run start <cs> --permission-mode manual on an accepted change set with no leaves exited 3 with 'has no leaves: ship-change builds and reviews its leaves, so plan it first' and next 'rhiza run start --workflow plan'; rhiza run status then said no runs yet and git worktree list showed only the main checkout. After adding two leaves the same command started the run.

Built binary, repo overrides run with --dry-run: a workflow step with no workflow, an unknown workflow, one including itself (w3 -> w3) and through another (w5 -> w4 -> w5), skip naming a step build lacks, and workflow on a command step were each refused with a message naming the cause. A real run of an outer workflow whose workflow step names a three-command inner workflow skipping its second ran inner/one and inner/three in order (two never ran, by its log) and the run succeeded. The built-in ship-change journaled build/build, build/check, review/code and review/review under their workflows' names.

Built binary in a ship-change run with fake rex/claude/gh and a real bare origin: open-pr pushed cs/ship-it and ran gh pr create --title 'Ship it' with a body starting '# Review of run <id>'; after request-changes added a fix commit, open-pr pushed it (origin's head moved to the fix's evidence commit) and ran gh pr edit 7 --body-file with no second pr create. run status named Pull request https://github.test/o/r/pull/7. ship open-pr outside a run and in a finished run exited 2 naming why.

Built binary, fake rex/claude/gh: ship-change stopped at signoff after pr-green with run status naming the PR URL and next run summary/approve/request-changes. request-changes with one qa finding on leaf first ran the fixer and verifier of first, then only qa as cycle 2 of review/review, then open-pr (pr edit), wait-pr, pr-green and signoff again. run approve then went on through rebase, land, merge (pr merge 7 --squash --match-head-commit), close-out and ship; the change set landed. approve and request-changes on the finished run both exited 2.

Built binary, fresh repo with no workflow overrides other than ship.sh, fake rex/claude/gh and bare origin: rhiza run start on two leaves (second depends on first) ran builder+verifier for first then second, render (commit 'Render after the build'), the built-in review's code check and five checks, open-pr, CI wait and stopped at signoff; approve landed the change set, squash-merged and closed out, and rhiza check on main passed. But a clean clone of the PR head before sign-off fails rhiza check (render committed actor pages whose log records stayed untracked); see this cycle's qa finding.
